# SAM2 pin

`Servers/SegmentationServer/Dockerfile` pins `facebookresearch/sam2` at `SAM2_GIT_SHA`.

When editing that Dockerfile or SAM2 integration, check https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam2/commits/main. If `main` is newer than the pinned SHA, tell James and do not silently unpin unless he asks.

For theory + API grounding before SAM2 plans or code changes, use `.cursor/skills/sam2-grounding/`.
